send_tagline: No account. No inbox. Just a link.
send_footnote: Files are deleted when the download limit or the expiry date is reached, whichever comes first.
send_lede: Drop it in, decide how many times it can be downloaded and when it stops working. The link takes care of the rest.
send_summary_unlimited: Anyone with the link gets unlimited downloads, and the link expires {expiry}.
send_summary_limited_one: The link stops working after 1 download, or expires {expiry}, whichever comes first.
send_summary_limited_other: The link stops working after {count} downloads, or expires {expiry}, whichever comes first.
send_uploading_hint: Keep this tab open until the link appears.
send_error_file_size_invalid: That file is empty or larger than {maxFileSize} MB. Choose a smaller one.
send_error_expires_on_invalid: Pick a date from today up to {days} days from now.
send_error_max_downloads_invalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more, or choose No limit.
download_footnote: Only download files from people you know.
download_fineprint: Each download counts toward the limit. After the last one, or on the expiry date, the file is deleted for good.
gone_body_expired: The file passed its expiry date and has been deleted.
gone_body_limit: The file reached its download limit and has been deleted.
gone_ask_again: Ask the person who sent it to share it again.
design_footnote: Static preview of every UI state. Not part of the product.
